bakes.name: Country Sourdough
bakes.description: The house loaf: white and stoneground wheat, a 24-hour cold prove, and a deep amber crust that crackles as it cools.
bakes.alt: Flour-dusted round sourdough boule with leaf-pattern scoring on a linen cloth

bakes.name: Seeded Rye
bakes.description: Dense, dark, and Nordic-leaning — cracked rye, sunflower, flax, and a spoonful of black treacle. Keeps all week.
bakes.alt: Fanned slices of dense dark rye bread with a seeded crust

bakes.name: Overnight Focaccia
bakes.description: An olive-oil slab proved overnight, dimpled with rosemary and flaky salt. Blistered top, custardy crumb.
bakes.alt: Golden rosemary focaccia cut into slices, glossy with olive oil

bakes.name: Cinnamon Knots
bakes.description: Cardamom-scented dough rolled through cinnamon butter, knotted by hand, and baked to a sticky finish.
bakes.alt: Glazed hand-tied cinnamon knots on a parchment-lined baking tray

bakes.name: Chocolate Babka
bakes.description: Braided brioche wound around dark chocolate and burnt honey. Historically, it does not survive Sunday.
bakes.alt: Chocolate swirl babka in a parchment-lined loaf tin seen from above

bakes.name: Lemon & Almond Cake
bakes.description: Whole-lemon and ground-almond cake with a crunchy sugar top — gluten-free by accident rather than by design.
bakes.alt: Homemade lemon cake dusted with icing sugar, one slice cut
